documents.text: Subscription payments may be reimbursed within fourteen days of purchase. Customers request reimbursement from the billing team and include their receipt number.
Borrowers can extend a library loan twice through the online catalogue. An item reserved by another reader cannot be renewed.
The backup service encrypts archived files before uploading them. Recovery requires the original secret key; losing that key makes the archive unreadable.
When the production service becomes unavailable, the on-call engineer rolls back the latest deployment. The incident commander posts progress updates every fifteen minutes.
Employees who forget their password can recover access through a verification link sent to their registered email address. The link expires after thirty minutes.
Staff members receive twenty days of paid annual leave. Requests must be approved by the employee's manager before travel is booked.
